## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and include a
small before/after example when useful.

## Compatibility and impact

Describe effects on public APIs, schemas, field IDs, wire formats, generated output,
resource limits, and performance, or state that none are expected.

## Verification

List the exact commands or checks you ran and their results. Identify untested
platforms or features and explain any checks you could not run. For documentation
changes, report link, consistency, and whitespace checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md, CodingStandard.md, and AGENTS.md.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant regression coverage, or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] I regenerated and exercised affected generated output, if applicable.
- [ ] I reviewed README.md and the integration skill and updated affected documentation.
- [ ] I described compatibility changes and verification limits above.
